title: Independent verification: endpoint-sweep audit of PR727 owner masks
head: 9f68dff1e1cccad2bd5b3b51f4ced0bba9765862
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independently verifies **Agastya Sondhi / @TMM2009’s PR727** at `71ba94c981477b3527ef21dd0f8140e795a7664d`, using a third footprint algorithm: sorted interval endpoints. **Status: independent verification and scoped tooling evidence; no new optimization or κ claim.**

```text
owner intervals → sort endpoints → reject overlap → sum lengths → check prefix/idle width
```

The new oracle uses neither bit masks nor per-coordinate occupancy sets. It reconstructs all **16,128 owner bins**, **280,592 occupied coordinates** and the complete idle histogram for **35,424 helper roles**. Original sets, PR727 masks and the endpoint oracle agree. The entire inherited checker receipt and relevant internal states are compared, including exact moment fractions.

This adds a different verification method, invalid interval enumeration, stateful sequence checks and same-input replay evidence. PR727 already supplied its own set/mask tests; this package credits that work and vendors four exact source/provenance files with their original notice. Only `research/owner-footprint-crosscheck/` is added, so it can be reviewed independently of PR727’s package.

Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. The selected #626/#543 result remains `51110230636731/31250000000000000`. `SOURCES.json` pins the 17 original inputs and four PR727 files with SHA-256 and Git blob identities. Native artifacts are archived PR622 outputs, not a fresh reconstruction.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/owner-footprint-crosscheck/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_OWNER_FOOTPRINT_CROSSCHECK ... sweep_owners=16128`.

- Complete-map replay; **21,500 exhaustive cases**, **6,000 sequential operations**, nine full-map corruptions, five actual-code mutations and four source-pin controls. Both complete engines reject with matching diagnostics; the independent oracle rejects all four footprint corruptions.
- Normal and optimized Python 3.12.12/3.14.7 checks pass. A minimal export replays from a path with spaces and an unrelated working directory. The four vendored files match PR727’s exact remote Git blobs.
- Fifteen alternating fresh-process pairs per interpreter: full-check median wall time **0.303022 → 0.274185 s (9.52% less)** on Python 3.12 and **0.297138 → 0.272085 s (8.43% less)** on Python 3.14. All 60 timed receipts match byte for byte. Both modes include the same source-admission harness, unlike the author’s direct-CLI reference setup; no claim to reproduce their absolute timings or percentages. Raw samples are retained. No RSS reduction or full-frontier speedup is claimed.
- Selected-record binding, all five existing selected-record tests, seven historical source inventories and staged whitespace checks pass. A final inventory check caught one agent-generated `.pyc`; only that cache was removed, with no reviewed source changes. Details are in `VALIDATION.md`.

No full repository suite, cold supplier replay, full controller/47-inequality assembly, Lean or remote CI pass is claimed. The oracle checks footprint accounting, not physical legality of its input windows. All inherited compiler/common-label/mutable-basis/hosting/residual/precision/tape/analytic assumptions remain.

Seed **89**, verification engineering. The final overlap refresh found PR727, so the overlapping optimization was retired and this independent audit was completed instead. No pinned coordination issue existed; the local claim contains the result and source link. Refresh through #767 found no endpoint-sweep audit of PR727; its pinned head and base main were unchanged.

Credit Agastya Sondhi/TMM2009 for the mask optimization; Chafik Boukhalfa/chafreaky for the independent checker; Jeremy Kothe/jeremykothe2, DreamingOfClouds, Rohan Arun, icekylinx, eumemic and the retained construction lineage. Prepared by **Brian / JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, Apache-2.0. “Independent” describes the endpoint algorithm and replay, not independent human review.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast Radius:** isolated research package. No existing source, default command, selected-frontier pointer or `upstream/` file changes.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
